findings.problem: The diff deletes both the `Math.min(100, ...)` clamp and the comment explaining it was there precisely because extracted archives have `local_size` (unpacked) greater than `remote_size` (compressed), which otherwise yields percentages like 199%. findings.title: Removed clamp lets percentDownloaded exceed 100 for extracted files
